caption: The drawing depicts a three-dimensional object resembling the head of a bird, specifically an eagle or similar raptor, positioned at an angle and isolated against a plain, light beige background. The object is rendered in shades of reddish-brown and dark brown, with detailed engraving indicating feathers and decorative motifs along the head and neck area. The beak is open, with both the upper and lower mandibles visible; the upper beak curves downward, while the lower beak is slightly shorter and curves upward. The surface of the object shows smooth transitions of light and shadow, giving a sense of depth and curvature, and the eye of the bird is clearly visible in relief, with minimal dot or line marking the pupil. The back end of the object is flat as if cut off, and the overall structure appears solid and carved, with feather patterns and spiral shapes around the base suggesting stylized ornamentation.
title: Eagle
